7a77e72ec3fb27917d72165d36949f0f24713dff.summary: CrowdStrike's technical analysis of WhisperGate, malware reported in January 2022 against Ukrainian targets. The malicious bootloader overwrites the master boot record of infected hosts, shows a ransom note, and corrupts disks. It has no decryption or recovery mechanism, and the report assesses it, with moderate confidence, as aimed at destroying data rather than genuine ransomware. It accompanies a file wiper and a Discord-based downloader. The report notes similarities to NotPetya but could not identify any technical overlap with VOODOO BEAR.
